name: dinghy-runtime-check
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,d=a.waterfrontDinghies;if(!d?.ready||d.hulls.length!==8||d.colliders.length!==8)throw Error('Dinghy runtime missing');for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const h=d.hulls[i],c=d.colliders[i],s=CITY.islandVergeSurfaceAt?.(h.x,h.z);if(Math.abs(h.y-c.minY)>.001||s&&Math.abs(s.h-h.y)>.001||!a.controllerManager.colliders.includes(c))throw Error('Dinghy ground/collider mismatch');}const ts=CITY.ezTreeDinghyStats;if(!ts||ts.mappedConflicts)throw Error('Mapped tree conflict '+JSON.stringify(ts));console.log('[dinghy-runtime] '+JSON.stringify({ready:d.ready,trees:ts,hulls:d.hulls}));})()
